name: Those Who Hurt Children
overview: Scripture reveals a solemn warning against harming children, emphasizing the sacredness of their place in God's kingdom and the severe judgment awaiting those who offend them. Jesus teaches that receiving a child in His name is akin to receiving Him, while those who cause harm to these little ones face dire consequences, symbolized by a millstone and drowning. The Word also instructs believers to nurture children in godly ways, ensuring they remain faithful throughout life, and assures that their angels continually behold God's face, highlighting their special protection and value. God's vengeance belongs to Him alone against those who commit abominations, including the mistreatment of children.
